title: Pan-Seared Pork Chops with German Infused Oil
description: A hearty pork chop recipe infused with the rich flavors of German spice, served with a side of savory goodness.
instructions: 1. Heat infused oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
2. Season pork chops with salt, pepper, and German spice blend.
3. Sear pork chops for 2-3 minutes per side, or until browned.
4. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until cooked through.
5. Meanwhile, sauté sliced onion and minced garlic in the skillet until softened.
6. Serve pork chops with the onion and garlic mixture, garnished with fresh herbs (optional).
8. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley or thyme, if desired.
9. Serve with additional German infused oil, if desired.
10. Clean and store leftover pork chops in an airtight container.
